post.text: AI Detectors found out "CANCELLED!" by Taylor Swift is 93.75% AI-generated. https://t.co/1WeVJadIxP

description.description: A close-up portrait of Taylor Swift against a white background. She has blonde hair with bangs, blue eyes, and pink lipstick. She is wearing a black spaghetti strap top and colorful, jewel-toned hoop earrings. In the foreground, there are iridescent, glittery textures in shades of green and purple.

A screenshot of an AI content detector tool showing a poem and its analysis. The top section contains a text box with lyrics about 'matching scars'. Below the text box, a button says 'Check Text' and a count of '389 words'. At the bottom, a horizontal bar chart indicates an AI probability of 93.75% and a Human probability of 6.25%, with a yellow status box stating 'This text is highly likely to be AI generated' from the website isitai.com.
